newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSES MIXED AHEAD OF WEEKEND.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSES MIXED AHEAD OF WEEKEND.

text.p: The Zimbabet was pretty stable until late in the afternoon when we started seeing some (foreign currency) buyers but I...think people were just squaring off their positions ahead of the weekend," one dealer said.
The local unit still managed to close at Thursday's 11.3975/4075 against the U.S. dollar but weakened against sterling to 19.2300/2500 from 19.1520/1900, tracking an easier U.S. dollar overseas.
It was quoted firmer on the mark at 6.5000/5200 compared to 6.5215/5450 but eased to 2.5200/5400 from 2.5175/5275 against South Africa's rand.
